rationale: All three findings from the final round are resolved. CR-001: vite.config.ts proxy target reverted to localhost:8080. CR-002: description trimmed at call site with workflow?.description?.trim() || undefined, preventing whitespace-only strings from rendering the empty div. CR-003: both integration tests now use data-testid='page-description' — the positive test asserts content via toHaveTextContent, the negative test asserts the element is absent via queryByTestId. No new high-risk issues introduced by the fix-up diff.

business_review.notes: PageLayout renders the description div between header and content with no permission gate. WorkflowDetailsPage passes description={workflow?.description}, visible to all users.
Plain <div> with break-words whitespace-pre-wrap. No input element. WorkflowExecutionConfigDetails renders no description.
ViewWorkflowConfiguration and WorkflowExecutionConfigDetails are unchanged. Unit test guards against accidental description rendering in the sidebar card.
Conditional render on workflow?.description; absent when undefined. Both cases covered by integration tests.
Marked out of scope in the spec; external docs team follow-up required.

standards_review.notes: Both commits follow EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence pattern.
TypeScript types correct (ReactNode prop, optional chaining at call site). React patterns consistent with codebase.

No auth, secrets, injection, or unsafe handling. Description rendered as plain text within a React div (XSS not a concern for string values; ReactNode type allows arbitrary elements but that is consistent with how subtitle/title/rightContent props work on the same component).
